children.name: OWASP Juice Shop
wrong password is rejected without saying which part was wrong
register, log in, see the account, log out @smoke
unknown email gets the same message as a wrong password
an email that is already registered cannot register again
invalid email "not-an-email" shows "Email address is not valid." and blocks submit
invalid password "abc" shows "Password must be 5-40 characters long." and blocks submit
passwords that do not match are flagged
the submit button only enables once every field is valid
adding from the product list updates the counter and the basket @smoke
+ and − change the quantity by one and the total with it; − stops at 1
removing the last item empties the basket and disables checkout
the total is the sum of price × quantity over all rows
the basket survives a reload and a new tab
one customer's basket is not visible to another
a guest basket is kept and merged into the account at login
the delivery page offers exactly the shop's delivery methods and prices
One Day Delivery: summary total = items + delivery
Fast Delivery: summary total = items + delivery
Standard Delivery: summary total = items + delivery
without a chosen address the next step stays disabled
UI-SEC-1: a search term is shown as text, never run as HTML
UI-A11Y-1: every basket row button has an accessible name
UI-A11Y-2: delivery radio buttons are named after their option
UI-TXT-1: an address without a State has no empty slot
UI-TXT-3: the card holder label is clean
UI-TXT-2: a one-day delivery says "1 Day"
UI-TXT-4: the password counter shows the real limit of 40
UI-AUTH-1: a guest who opens the order history is sent to log in
